description: Which side of the plane to sit on: for a flight between two US airports (all of Florida's plus the big ones with nonstops to Florida), the big sights you can see from the window in flight order (Lake Okeechobee, the Sunshine Skyway, the Vehicle Assembly Building, the Seven Mile Bridge, the Outer Banks, Manhattan, the Grand Canyon...), left or right side, about when, the states under the route, and tips for getting GPS to work in airplane mode. Use it when someone picks a seat, asks what they will see from the plane, or asks why their GPS dot disappears in the air.
name: window_seat
title: Window seat sights
